exceptions.dashes.exclude: vendor/katex/** is third-party minified code, pinned by build/check-vendored.mjs; LICENSE and LICENSE-*.txt are the license texts, verbatim.
exceptions.leak.exclude: vendor/katex/** is third-party minified code, pinned by build/check-vendored.mjs.
exceptions.leak.emailAllow: ingest@epistack.local is the invented contact address periphery/ingest/openalex.mjs sends to OpenAlex's polite pool; .local is not a deliverable domain and the address belongs to no one.
exceptions.provenance: not enabled: no source is landed with bytes yet (status ledger [5.2]); receipts are a kernel record here, verified by build/check-standing.mjs.
exceptions.receipts: not enabled: requires provenance, and this repository's receipts are claim-graph records (kernel/schema/provenance.mjs), not landed-excerpt receipts.
exceptions.repomap: not enabled: build/check-map.mjs keeps a typed map that enforces the trust boundary; describing every file in repo-map-manifest.json as well is a migration of its own (Repo-Infrastructure FUNCTIONS F9 names absorbing typed edges).
exceptions.docgraph: not enabled: build/check-docs.mjs checks the same typed front matter and the code chain besides, and deliberately excludes the two outward pages the kit's docgraph would fail.
exceptions.tokens: not enabled: 16 stylesheets predate the Ledger tokens, the competition submission page among them; moving them is interface work to be checked by eye in a browser, not a gate change.
exceptions.corrections: not enabled: corrections here are dated notes in place and the compost ledger, which build/check-self-description.mjs and the status ledger hold; there is no corrections.js.
exceptions.freshness: not enabled: build/check-all.mjs regenerates every generated file and compares it with the committed copy.
